source_workspace: Roboflow tdt4265-vd97u / NTNU Road Damage Dataset
critical_finding: The Norway RDD2022 split has virtually zero pothole annotations (0 in train, 1 in val). Because ground-truth pothole denominator is essentially zero, any calculated mAP50 for potholes on this split (such as the earlier 0.001) is statistically meaningless and misleading. Consequently, 0.001 mAP has been purged from all project claims and documentation.

held_out_pothole_benchmark_status.required_format: YOLO format .txt bounding boxes on dedicated unseen test set
